ns2:course.label: Clinical Case Project in Communication Sciences and Disorders
ns2:course.description: Students will complete a summative individual clinical case project to evaluate the student’s attained knowledge required to assess and treat individuals with communication disorders and apply that knowledge to authentic, clinically relevant situations. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: Successful completion of Year 1 Master's in Speech & Hearing Science, Clinical Program curriculum, and approval of academic advisor.
